text:
marcus.w: published 0.9.8-canary to npm and wheel ~20:14 PT. Quick smoke looks okay but telemetry shows a TS-only serializer TypeError creeping up. leaning to pin npm.
anya: can you paste the error trace?
marcus.w: small snippet: `TypeError: Cannot read property 'length' of undefined at serializer.ts:112` — only from browser/edge clients so far.
sophia.k: if it's TS-specific, pin npm dist-tag back to 0.9.7 and block further TS publishes. keep PyPI live.
eli: agree. Also recommend a 2-hour publish hold and a brief customer note in release notes.
marcus.w: running commands now
marcus.w: ```bash
# pin back to previous "latest"
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk-ts@0.9.7
npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk-ts 0.9.8-canary
# deprecate if necessary with pointer to safe version
npm deprecate @redwood/sdk-ts@0.9.8-canary "yanked: use 0.9.7 until hotfix published"
```
deploy-bot: starting canary-watch for release 0.9.8-canary (channel devex).
deploy-bot: canary metrics: 150rps, errors +0.9% ↑, no alert threshold yet.
anya: add rollback criteria: error rate >1.5% sustained 5m or increase in front-end user errors -> yank.
sophia.k: Ops preference: avoid npm unpublish. use dist-tag + deprecate. add explicit install examples for customers needing immediate fix.
eli: propose hotfix flow: branch patch -> small fix -> CI -> publish 0.9.8-hotfix. verify canary then promote. target time: 60m.
marcus.w: I'll prepare patch branch and a minimal repro test. tagging support for canned reply.
anya: Also note: coordinate with devex docs to add a short note in release log saying: "0.9.8-canary: TS serializer issue observed; npm latest pinned to 0.9.7; hotfix in progress."
sophia.k: I'll draft the blurb and include pinned install snippets:
```bash
# to pin client to safe version (TS)
npm install @redwood/sdk-ts@0.9.7
# PyPI unchanged unless you opted into canary
pip install redwood-sdk==0.9.7
```
marcus.w: pinned npm back to 0.9.7, left PyPI alone. posted commands above.
deploy-bot: release note created: "0.9.8-canary: observed serializer TypeError in TS clients; npm pinned to 0.9.7; hotfix planned." (link: https://console.internal/releases/1746778888)
eli: Good. Ops: avoid publishing other SDK packages for next 2 hours.
anya: If hotfix fails CI, we escalate to full yank + deprecate messaging and support FAQ.
sophia.k: I'll finish the release note and add a short step-by-step for support engineers.
marcus.w: will update thread when hotfix build is ready. holding other TS publishes for 120 minutes.
anya: ping me if rollback criteria breach.
marcus.w: thanks everyone.
